question.text: A client asks the PM to invest funds in 'a fund of PMS portfolios'. The PM must:

answer.text: Decline — PMs shall not invest in another PM's portfolio

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation prohibits investing clients' funds in another PM's portfolio. The Trap: Agreeing breaches SEBI rules. Cross-Exam Context: Same rule in III-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Document the rejection in writing; rule-based rejections protect the PM.
